name: bludit-wizard-mcp
description: Universal remote MCP server for Bludit CMS: Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1, on Cloudflare Workers. Derived from bludit/bludit-mcp (MIT).

contributors.name: Diego Najar
contributors.comment: Original author of bludit/bludit-mcp, the upstream project this is derived from.

contributors.name: Evan Zellner
contributors.comment: Bludit Wizard MCP: hosted Worker, OAuth 2.1 authorization server, tool expansion, tests and documentation.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply bludit-wizard-mcp --config wrangler.auth.jsonc --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply bludit-wizard-mcp --config wrangler.auth.jsonc --remote
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
